rows.sourceShownText: `package.json` `bin.fgos` is removed (or pointed at the workspace shim) when the Rust host becomes the installed default; `bin.fgos-runner` stays until the runner migrates. A header in `bin/fgos.mjs` and the root `AGENTS.md` state the ownership rule for editors already at that path.
rows.targetShownText:
## Proposed Disposition

Added in candidate — propose retirement of the automatic installed-default removal or redirection trigger. Keep the npm compatibility mapping, runner mapping and source-entry ownership header under their existing support and release policy. This does not decide when the npm fallback channel ends, extend its support promise, or remove a payload.

The current `package.json:9-12` maps both npm entries to the Node payload. `bin/fgos.mjs:4-10` expressly retains global npm and direct Node compatibility channels while requiring Rust host payload resolution through manifest fields. The source obligation was introduced by `4db6ee7e5d32efdd10ebfdc6aa71816e1f98754f`; the implementation header added by `c831811faaa0be93f505456aae6a134865ccbc9b` explicitly retained npm compatibility and did not remove that mapping. The candidate spec distinguishes the native public/default posture from the deprecated npm channel.

The current code proves coexistence, not intentional retirement of the original obligation. No commit explicitly retiring the trigger was found by the recorded symbol/history search. Independent review must decide whether this proposal becomes a retirement verdict or whether a restoration remains owed. Until that verdict, dropped-010 stays deferred to Packaging-distribution and its FLAGGED-obsolete literal retention is unchanged.
rows.owedObligation: Removing or redirecting bin.fgos after the window remains owed to Packaging-distribution (release-owner decision). Nothing is removed now.

ownerResolution.text:
F6 resolution (owner-decided 2026-10-14, option A of the Step 4 decision, following `review-4-packaging-truth-f6.md` part 2): dropped-010 is superseded by decision, not retired by absence.
1. The installed-default removal trigger for npm `bin.fgos` is superseded by the 2026-09-15 coordinator decision (`docs/platform/packaging-distribution/code-panel-rollout-plan.md:72`, with the `architecture/release-boundaries.md:35` row): the Rust host is the installed default from the preview, and the Node fallback is deprecated and supported for 30 calendar days, earliest removal 2026-10-18. The disposition cites that decision as its successor.
2. Removing or redirecting `bin.fgos` after the window stays an owed obligation, owned by Packaging-distribution (release-owner decision). The disposition text says so; nothing is removed now.
3. The rationale says "superseded by decision" and drops the "no intentional retirement is inferred from absence" wording. The FLAGGED-obsolete verbatim retention may now be resolved consistently with this verdict. The runner mapping and source-entry ownership header stay.
